Light Screen when special damage is the killer
Machamp No Guard Dynamic Punch confusion
Chansey Seismic Toss / Soft-Boiled / Helping Hand
Umbreon Foul Play punishes physical attackers
Hydreigon is the fast special mode

attempts.why: Turn 1 Meganium Protected the Overheat, Fake Out flinched Machamp. Turn 2 Meganium Mega Evolved and chose Light Screen but Chi-Yu outsped and Overheat OHKO'd it (349); Dynamic Punch confused the incoming Landorus. Machamp Protected turn 3 (empty). Turn 4 Earth Power KO'd Machamp, Close Combat OHKO'd Chansey (669 HP through Eviolite). Turn 5 the AI switched Probopass out for Umbreon into Earth Power; Close Combat OHKO'd Hydreigon before its Draco Meteor (Urshifu 309 Speed vs 308). Turn 6 Earth Power OHKO'd Probopass and Close Combat finished Umbreon. Zero faints.

strategy_checks.evidence: a1: Protect, Light Screen, dead. a2: Giga Drain x3, Protect. Heal Pulse never used across 6 Meganium turns. ai_notes: Probopass switching out of a 4x Earth Power for Umbreon (a1 t5) was a genuinely good read. Chansey choosing Helping Hand beside a Machamp that was about to be KO'd (a1 t4) is weak but not illegal. The wall never walled: every member except Umbreon was OHKO'd by one super-effective hit in at least one run.

OHKO'd by Earth Power in both runs, never set Stealth Rock

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 6-0 with no real threat. The Mega and the attackers keep their offsets; the two walls that folded fastest go +1. Levels will not make a Fighting/Ground-weak stall team survive Urshifu + Landorus; see cooler.
cooler: The concept (a stall gate) is right for the gauntlet, but it is undone by an engine fact: Mega Meganium loses Triage to Mega Sol, so the signature Triage Heal Pulse can never happen on the Mega. Either Meganium should hold a non-Mega item (Leftovers, keeping Triage and the priority heal, with the Mega slot moving to Machamp - Machampite is in the pool) or Heal Pulse should come from a Triage body that is not the Mega. Also every wall is Fighting-weak (Chansey, Umbreon, Probopass) or Ground-weak (Probopass 4x) - one Fighting-resist body (Slowbro/Clefable-class) would make 'you cannot out-grind this team' true. Sets unchanged in this pass.
legality_notes: Authored ability TRIAGE is legal on base Meganium, but the plan's 'Mega Meganium uses Heal Pulse ... through Triage' contradicts the engine (Mega form ability = MEGA_SOL). Flagged for the main agent.
verification_limit: The +1 on Chansey and Probopass cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds; this is not the battle most worth re-running (the outcome does not hinge on those two).
